title: promote-release: a RESUMED promotion must also refuse when a current latest is newer than --version
description:
Twin of lore-cli LCLI-638 (on lore dev at 640195ec), found by lore's reviewer on LCLI-631 and sent here on 2026-09-28. lore will not diverge alone, so both sides fix it as a pair.

DEFECT: QCLI-402 (#369) refuses a --version older than the current npm latest only on a FRESH run. On a resume, planPromotion skips validateRecord, and main() validates only the reused record against {version}. So nothing compares a package's CURRENT latest with --version. If the registry moved ahead between the two runs, a resume moves latest backwards.

REPRODUCED HERE on quest dev (scripts/promote-release.mjs blob 1aa90887), not taken on relay: planPromotion with version 5.6.7, launcher 5.6.7-rc.1 and every package's latest at 5.7.0. resuming false gives ok:false with 14 problems, headlined "5.6.7 is older than the current latest 5.7.0". resuming true gives ok:true. lore's end-to-end probe: a record for 5.6.7 with prior 5.6.6, every current latest at 5.7.0; --promote exits 0 and moves everything back to 5.6.7.

LIKELIHOOD: low. It needs latest to move ahead between the first run and the resume, which in practice means quest moved as well.

SUGGESTED RULE (lore's, to be matched by verdict, not by text): on resume, refuse when any package's current latest is strictly newer than --version. Keep accepting a package already at --version, since that is what a resume is for. Anything older than --version still resumes normally.

acceptanceCriteria.text: On --promote and --dry-run with an existing record (resume), promote-release.mjs refuses before any dist-tag moves when any package's CURRENT latest is strictly newer than --version, naming the package and both versions
A resume where some packages already read --version and the rest read an older release still proceeds (the case resume exists for)
The fresh-run refusals from QCLI-402 are unchanged, and the new refusal is covered by a test that fails against the pre-change script

lore-cli confirms the refuse/accept verdicts match LCLI-638 over a resume grid (resuming true, current latest newer / equal / older than --version, uniform and single-package-differing) at both final heads

plan: 1. Branch fix/QCLI-405-resume-refuses-newer-latest off origin/dev (twin of lore LCLI-638, head 2b97082c read directly)

2. In planPromotion, add the RESUME refusal: any package whose current latest is strictly newer than --version refuses before any write, naming the package and both versions; equal-to-version and older still resume (mirror LCLI-638 by verdict)
3. Mirror lore LCLI-638 second half: fresh-run non-plain current latest refused with a registry-terms headline (verdict unchanged, message parity)

4. Add test/qcli405-resume-refuses-newer-latest.test.ts covering resume newer/equal/older/non-plain x uniform/single-platform/launcher/half; prove it fails against the pre-change script (AC3 control), then passes
5. Diff the resume grid with lore-cli at both final heads and send them my verdict column (AC4)
6. npm run check green; PR into dev naming the run id; close ACs 1-4 with evidence

Mirrors lore LCLI-638 at 2b97082c, read from lore source rather than the relay. Equal-to-version and older still resume; a non-plain current latest is ACCEPTED on resume, the residual both sides pinned as an explicit grid row. Second half mirrored too: a fresh run whose current latest is not plain is refused with a registry-terms headline instead of the validateRecord recorded-prior wording (verdict unchanged). EVIDENCE: test/qcli405-resume-refuses-newer-latest.test.ts; against the pre-change script (origin/dev blob 1aa90887) it is 3 pass / 4 fail; post-fix the 10 promote-related test files are 119 pass / 0 fail; npm run check exits 0 (966 pass / 0 fail, 109 files). PAIRING GRID (lore recipe, 40 rows): quest post-fix 20 of 40 accepted, identical to lore column row for row; pre-fix control 25 of 40, differences exactly the 5 resume-newer rows. AC1-AC3 checked; AC4 waits on the lore final head, where both columns get re-derived at both final heads.

CORRECTION, same day: the first cut of this fix mirrored lore LCLI-638 at 2b97082c and ACCEPTED a non-plain current latest on resume, as both sides had briefly agreed. lore reviewer found that wrong by measurement: a live 5.7.0-rc.1 with --version 5.6.7 was accepted and performed the full backwards move, because semver precedence is decided by MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH first (5.7.0-rc.1 is NEWER than 5.6.7). The rule now compares the release the live value LEADS WITH (leadingReleaseVersion, the same regex plus compareReleaseVersions as lore at 7c193ca3) and refuses a strictly newer leading release; a tie such as 5.6.7-rc.1 or 5.6.7+build.7 over 5.6.7 stays accepted, and a value leading with no release is unorderable and stays accepted. GRID regenerated to the lore 70-row recipe: quest 25 of 70 accepted, same shape as lore column; pre-fix control 40 of 70 with 15 differences, exactly the resume plain-newer, prerelease-newer and build-newer rows. The refusal message also drops the restore-first remedy (lore measured that --rollback refuses in the refused state and the manual tag move is unpinned), matching lore.

finalSummary:
promote-release.mjs now refuses a RESUMED promotion, before any dist-tag moves, when any package's CURRENT npm latest is strictly newer than --version, naming the package and both versions. It compares the release the live value LEADS WITH under semver precedence, so 5.7.0-rc.1 over 5.6.7 is refused while 5.6.7-rc.1 and 5.6.7+build.7 over 5.6.7 are not, and a value leading with no release is unorderable and stays accepted -- the one deliberate residual both sides pinned as an explicit grid row. Equal and older still resume, which is the case resume exists for. The fresh-run side also gained the registry-terms headline for a non-plain current latest, replacing validateRecord's recorded-prior wording with no change of verdict. Mirrored from lore-cli's LCLI-638; the pairing is pinned by a 70-row grid each side runs through its own planPromotion.

Verified. The grid is test/qcli405-resume-refuses-newer-latest.test.ts, asserting 70 rows and exactly 25 accepted (lines 282-283), passing at dev tip a77d17ab (7 pass / 0 fail, 133 expect() calls). Against the pre-change script (origin/dev blob 1aa90887) the same test is 2 pass / 5 fail, and the pre-fix grid control is 40 of 70 accepted with 15 differences -- exactly the resume newer, prerelease-newer and build-newer rows. npm run check exits 0 (966 pass / 0 fail, 109 files) at the fix head 68bebc83. AC4: lore's dev read by ref (f3305628 landed as an ancestor of fee53bc6, promote-latest.mjs blob 9f020305 byte-identical at both), and the two test files compared directly -- same axes in the same order, same expected column, 25 of 70, each side's CI green at its own head. This closure commit is tracker-only, so the source evidence above still describes the tree it closes over.
